format: HTML with embedded JavaScript and template syntax
description: HTML template for campaign zone management in Revive Adserver, including form elements, tables for available and linked zones, and JavaScript for dynamic interactions.

methods.name: sendZonesRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX GET request to fetch zone data for a specific panel.

methods.name: sendLinkingRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX POST request to link or unlink zones and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: updatePanel
methods.description: Updates the zone table panel with new data received from server.

methods.name: addMultiselectListeners
methods.description: Adds event listeners for multi-checkbox selection changes.

methods.name: addSelectAllListeners
methods.description: Adds event listeners for select-all checkbox actions.

methods.name: cancelAllZonesSelection
methods.description: Resets all zone selection states for a panel.

methods.name: checkReload
methods.description: Checks if server response indicates a need to reload the page.

methods.name: extractPart
methods.description: Extracts specific parts of server response data based on markers.
